content.short: Kalshi is a CFTC regulated event contract exchange whose markets are also available as tokenized contracts on Solana.
content.description: Kalshi is a prediction market operating as a CFTC regulated designated contract market in the United States, listing event contracts on elections, economic data releases, sports, and weather. Its distinguishing feature is the regulatory footing: contracts are legally recognised derivatives, not offshore products. Kalshi has since extended onchain, issuing tokenized versions of its event contracts on Solana so crypto native traders can settle quickly and cheaply, with protocols such as DFlow and Jupiter bridging its off chain order book to onchain liquidity.
